setup.noDiscord: No Discord identity. Start Discord and reconnect — FredPD identifies officers by Discord account.
setup.noToken: No Discord bot token in config/server.lua. Add one, restart the resource and try again.
setup.discordFailed: Discord could not be reached. Check the token and the guild id in config/server.lua.
setup.noRoles: You hold no roles in that Discord server. Give yourself one, then run setup again.
setup.failed: Setup could not be written to the database. The server console has the reason.

health.title: System health
health.intro: Counters the server already holds. Gateway status, database latency, route timings and queue depths are not measured yet, so they are not shown.
health.gridNote: Totals for the whole server, since the resource last started: never a trace, a player or an owner. Destroyed counts traces wiped away or picked up out of the world; cleaning blood is not counted, because a cleaned pool stays where it is and luminol still finds it. Destruction by a player takes no police clearance and leaves no audit entry, so for them this counter is the only record there is; an officer who destroys evidence is also logged as forensics.destroyed in the audit log.

confirm.haktning: Häktning is the court’s decision. It ends the RB 24:13 deadline and the person stays in custody.
confirm.frigiv: Releasing ends the detention. A later arrest is a new chain with its own statutory clocks, not a reopening of this one.
